description: iPhone screenshot, shown inside the iOS Photos app, of a photographed screen displaying John Solomon's Twitter profile (@jsolomonReports, 6,578 Tweets). The profile is covered by Twitter's restriction interstitial warning that the account is temporarily restricted due to unusual activity, with a 'Yes, view profile' button. Status bar shows 12:07 and the photo is timestamped Today 12:06 PM.
text: 12:07. LTE. Today. 12:06 PM. Edit. John Solomon. 6,578 Tweets. John Solomon. @jsolomonReports. Caution: This account is temporarily res[tricted]. You're seeing this warning because there has been some unus[ual activity from] this account. Do you still want to view it?. Yes, view profile.

description: Screenshot of a verified Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) tweet from December 11, 2015, calling Saudi Prince Alwaleed bin Talal 'Dopey Prince' and claiming he wants to control U.S. politicians with 'daddy's money', adding that he can't do it once Trump is elected. Shows 19.8K likes and 22.4K people tweeting about it.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Dopey Prince @Alwaleed_Talal wants to control our U.S. politicians with daddy's money. Can't do it when I get elected. #Trump2016. 10:53 PM · Dec 11, 2015. 19.8K. 22.4K people are Tweeting about this.
flags: The tweet's claim about Alwaleed bin Talal controlling politicians is Trump's assertion, not established fact

description: Movie-poster-style QAnon digital artwork in red and black. A large stylized portrait of Donald Trump's face dominates, with the Washington Monument, U.S. Capitol dome, and presidential seal in the background. Tagline text declares 'The Hunt Is On' and 'Hunters Become the Hunted — Patriots in Control', dedicating the piece to Trump, 'Q-Team patriots' and 'anons' of the Great Awakening. A 'Cross & Country' artist logo sits in the lower right corner.
text: BELOW THE DEPTHS OF THE D.C. SWAMP. THE HUNT IS ON. In the invisible war for the future of our Republic, the tables are now turned. And now, the... HUNTERS BECOME THE HUNTED. PATRIOTS IN CONTROL. IN HONOR OF DONALD J. TRUMP, Q-TEAM PATRIOTS, ALL ANONS & EVERY MEMBER OF THE GREAT AWAKENING ENGAGED IN THE HUNT. WWG1WGA!. ENJOY THE SHOW!. CROSS & COUNTRY.
flags: QAnon promotional artwork; its 'invisible war' and 'patriots in control' framing is the artwork's claim, not fact

description: Photograph inside the Air Force One conference cabin as a wall-mounted TV shows a Fox News chyron announcing that Supreme Court Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg has died at age 87 (September 18, 2020). White House aides in suits confer around the cabin: Stephen Miller stands at upper left, Hope Hicks sits in a blue sweater at center, and Dan Scavino sits beside her with a MacBook. A blond-haired figure seen blurred from behind in the right foreground is consistent with President Donald Trump. A digital cabin clock shows Washington time.
text: WHITE HOUSE. SUPREME COURT JUSTICE RUTH BADER GINSBURG DIES AT AGE 87 FOLLOWING BATTLE WITH CANCER. WASHINGTON. 09. 140.
flags: Foreground blond figure seen only from behind is consistent with Donald Trump but not certain
Two other seated men in suits could not be identified with confidence and are left unnamed
